rule.summary: Call-tile names: a line that is only a person-shaped name, persisting across the call window rows.
rule.call_rows: call-window rows only: never a messaging app (telegram, discord, slack, whatsapp); a window title starting "Meet -"/"Meet –"/"Meet —" + text is a call; otherwise the row must be conferencing (appName contains zoom, microsoft teams, webex, facetime, or appName+title contains zoom, microsoft teams, webex, facetime, google meet, meet.google) AND show call evidence in that window: a word-bounded call-control marker in title+OCR (mute, unmute, end call, hang up, leave call, stop video, start video, screen share, screenshare, in call, in-call, camera off, camera on) or a title containing the word "zoom meeting", "meeting", "call", "webinar" or "huddle". A row matched only by a Meet URL in its OCR does not count.
rule.line: clean the line; strip trailing decorations ("(...)", "h:mm AM/PM", "· ..."); reject if it contains "@", "http", or a Meet code xxx-xxxx-xxx
rule.tokens: 2-4 tokens, <=60 chars; each token is a lowercase particle (al bin da de del der di du la le van von, never first or last) or starts with an uppercase letter, contains only letters and - ' ’, and has at least one lowercase letter
rule.chrome_words: reject when any casefolded token is in the chrome list, the non-person list, or the joiner list (see meeting_context.py _TILE_CHROME_WORDS/_NON_PERSON_WORDS/_JOINER_WORDS)
rule.owner: exclude a name seen with a trailing "(...you...)" marker on any call row, a supplied owner name (casefold equal, or same first and last token), or whose tokens joined equal an owner email local part with . _ - + removed
rule.ai_agents: exclude when any whole token (casefolded, edge . ' ’ - trimmed) is agent ai assistant boardy bot chatbot companion fathom fireflies gemini granola meetbot notebot notes notetaker otter recorder tldv; never a suffix match ("James Talbot" is human). Agent tiles that pass every other tile rule are returned separately (call_tile_agent_names / expected_agent_names) when the roster classifier also calls them agents, and join the participants as agents; expected_participant_names lists only the human participants.
rule.window_title: exclude when the name equals a part of any call row window title split on " - ", " – ", " — ", " | ", " : ", each part with a leading "(N) " counter and trailing non-word characters removed
rule.chrome_elsewhere: non-call rows = rows that are not call-window rows but share an appName with a call row; with >=3 of them, exclude a name appearing in more than 50% of them
rule.count: count each name once per row; order by count desc then first appearance; cap 8
rule.merge: tile names append after roster-sentence and email-corroborated names, case-insensitively deduplicated
rule.conferencing_rows: the existing conferencing classifier (is_conferencing_row / conferencingPlatform) now also accepts a window title starting "Meet -"/"Meet –"/"Meet —" followed by text (a named Meet), so a named-Meet call yields a context
